description: This file defines runtime environment types, utility functions for output handling (logging, errors, stdout, JSON), and functions to create runtime objects with specific behaviors (e.g., with or without exit). It manages runtime I/O, terminal state restoration, and conditional logging based on environment variables.

methods.name: function shouldEmitRuntimeLog(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): boolean { shouldEmitRuntimeLog
methods.description: Determines if runtime log output should be emitted based on environment variables.

methods.name: function shouldEmitRuntimeStdout(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): boolean { shouldEmitRuntimeStdout
methods.description: Checks whether stdout output should be emitted, influenced by environment variables.

methods.name: function isPipeClosedError(err: unknown): boolean { isPipeClosedError
methods.description: Checks if an error corresponds to a closed pipe or input/output error.

methods.name: function hasRuntimeOutputWriter( hasRuntimeOutputWriter
methods.description: Type guard to determine if runtime supports writeStdout and writeJson methods.

methods.name: function writeStdout(value: string): void { writeStdout
methods.description: Writes a string to stdout if enabled, handling line endings and pipe errors.

methods.name: function createRuntimeIo(): Pick<OutputRuntimeEnv, "log" | "error" | "writeStdout" | "writeJson"/ createRuntimeIo
methods.description: Creates an IO object with log, error, writeStdout, and writeJson methods based on environment variables.

methods.name: export function createNonExitingRuntime(): OutputRuntimeEnv { createNonExitingRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime environment that throws on exit instead of actually exiting.

methods.name: export function writeRuntimeStdout(runtime: RuntimeEnv | OutputRuntimeEnv, value: string): void / writeRuntimeStdout
methods.description: Writes to runtime's stdout or logs, depending on runtime capabilities.

methods.name: export function writeRuntimeJson( writeRuntimeJson
methods.description: Outputs JSON data via runtime's writeJson or logs it.

ctags.name: maybeMockedLog
ctags.pattern: /^  const maybeMockedLog = console.log as unknown as { mock?: unknown };$/

ctags.name: writeRuntimeStdout
ctags.pattern: /^export function writeRuntimeStdout(runtime: RuntimeEnv | OutputRuntimeEnv, value: string): void /
